content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is post-specific. Qualification, experience and age limit for each post are given in the sections below. In addition, the notification lays down these general conditions: Candidates must be citizens of India. Persons who migrated from Pakistan with the intention of permanently settling in India, or subjects of Nepal, are also eligible, but a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India will be necessary for appointment. Such candidates should apply to the Government of India in the Ministry of Home Affairs for the certificate and furnish satisfactory proof of having applied. The prescribed qualifications are minimum. Unless specified, they are required for consideration even if a higher qualification has been acquired, and possessing a higher qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will be considered. Minimum requirements of qualification and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. The required experience is relaxable at the Institute's discretion for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe candidates, if at any stage of selection the competent authority is of the opinion that a sufficient number of candidates from these communities with the requisite experience are not likely to be available to fill the vacancy reserved for them. The crucial date for determining eligibility in every respect is the prescribed closing date for submission of online application, 06.11.2026. Applicants already working in any project at IIT Madras must apply through proper channel. Otherwise, they must produce a No-Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification / test / interview. Candidates without NOC will not be permitted to appear for the test / interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not list fixed selection stages. It states the following: Candidates will be short-listed for Test / Interview on the basis of the information provided in their online applications. They must ensure that this information is true. The Institute has the right to decide the mode of screening and testing the applicants for short-listing and selection. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for written / skill test / interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications, level and relevance of experience above the minimum prescribed, and other academic achievements. Calling a candidate for test / interview only indicates that the candidate may be suitable. It gives no assurance of recommendation or selection. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All correspondence will be made by e-mail only. Admission to any stage of selection is purely provisional, subject to confirmation that the candidate satisfies the prescribed eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Recruitment 2026 Job Description and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: For the ICMR project "MolOnco-DnT-CenTr: Translational Centre For Diagnostic And Therapeutic Technologies in Molecular Oncology", the role involves: Leading the development and optimization of U-bent fiber-optic biosensor platforms for sensitive and specific detection of DNA/RNA biomarkers associated with gastric cancer and other molecular oncology applications. Designing and optimizing bioassay strategies, including capture-probe functionalization, hybridization/sandwich assays, antibody–nanoparticle conjugation and signal amplification. Independently developing and validating DNA/RNA and antigen-based assays, with emphasis on sensitivity, specificity, reproducibility and robustness. Developing surface functionalization, biomolecule immobilization and stabilization strategies. Integrating bioassays with optical/plasmonic readout systems and developing multiplexed diagnostic platforms. Planning analytical and bioanalytical validation studies. Coordinating clinical sample testing and validation, and leading translation of laboratory-scale assays into prototype point-of-care diagnostic devices. Coordinating project staff, research fellows and students. Troubleshooting experimental, biochemical, optical and instrumentation challenges. Maintaining experimental records, datasets, SOPs and technical documentation, and ensuring project milestones and deliverables are achieved. Contributing to reports, publications, patents, proposals and technology-transfer activities, mentoring junior researchers, and collaborating with clinical, biological, engineering and translational research teams. For the ICMR project "MolOnco-DnT-CenTr: Translational Centre For Diagnostic And Therapeutic Technologies in Molecular Oncology", the role involves: Contributing to the design, development and validation of a plasmonic fiber optic biosensor for the detection of DNA biomarkers associated with gastric cancer. Strategic design and development of a U-bent fiber optic biosensor platform, including probe surface functionalization with capture oligonucleotides, conjugation of 5-methylcytosine antibodies with gold nanoparticles for plasmonic signal generation, and establishment of a hybrid sandwich assay for sensitive and specific detection of selected methylated DNA biomarkers. Assay development for given DNA/RNA or antigen targets, and stabilization of antibodies and oligonucleotides to achieve a minimum one-year shelf-life of point-of-care devices, while ensuring reliability and reproducibility of the assays. Optimization of biosensor parameters such as probe chemistry, conjugation strategies and signal amplification to maximize sensitivity and specificity, followed by translation of the optimized assay onto a multiplex detection platform for faster and higher-throughput analysis. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) for temporary positions under its Applied Mechanics and Biomedical Engineering department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The position notified is Project Research Scientist III under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt.211/2026 for research-focused temporary job requirements.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for the Project Research Scientist III position across the department projects at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to successfully register and submit the online application form is 6 November 2026 through the official recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist III?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Research Scientist III post will receive a salary of INR 78,000 per month along with an additional 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants require a Post Graduate Degree, a Four Years Graduate degree or PG degree in Engineering / IT / CS, or a PhD with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying to the Project Research Scientist III post is set up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications exclusively through online mode by visiting the official career webpage provided by IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a written or skill test and interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates need to send a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No, candidates should not send the hard copy of the application to the Institute initially; they must keep a printout safely to submit when called for test or interview.
